The initial body mass places this species among the smaller-known gerreid hatchlings, although variability in yolk provisioning across populations remains poorly documented.

Juveniles of Gerres longirostris recruit to shallow, sandy-bottom habitats where they undergo a period of accelerated somatic growth.
